title: Illinois drops its 200-transaction test
detail: Illinois removes the 200-transaction threshold, leaving $100,000 or more in cumulative gross receipts from sales to Illinois purchasers during the lookback period as the only threshold.
who: Remote retailers and marketplace facilitators selling into Illinois

title: CBP electronic refunds rule takes effect
detail: Subject to limited exceptions, CBP now issues all refunds electronically.
who: Importers and others who receive refunds from CBP

title: De minimis suspension continued for all countries
detail: Under Executive Order 14388, for goods entered on or after 12:01 a.m. EST, de minimis does not apply (except for articles covered by 50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), regardless of value, origin, transport mode or entry method.
who: Importers of low-value shipments from any country

title: Section 122 surcharge of 10% begins
detail: Proclamation 11012 imposes a 10% ad valorem temporary import surcharge under section 122, starting at 12:01 a.m. EST.
who: Importers of goods covered by the surcharge

title: Section 232 metals duties move to full value
detail: For goods entered on or after this date, Section 232 metals duties apply to the full customs value of the product, regardless of metal content.
who: Importers of steel, aluminum and copper articles and derivatives

title: De minimis suspended for non-postal shipments
detail: CBP's interim final rule took effect, and CBP names Entry Type 11 as the main informal entry method for these shipments.
who: Importers of low-value shipments arriving by modes other than mail

title: Postal de minimis rule takes effect
detail: CBP's postal rule took effect (its 19 CFR 145.31 suspension took effect June 24), with a new postal informal entry for mail shipments valued at $2,500 or less, subject to conditions.
who: Senders and importers of mail shipments

title: Section 122 surcharge period ends
detail: The 150-day surcharge was set to run through 12:01 a.m. EDT on this date unless extended by an Act of Congress.
who: Importers of goods covered by the surcharge

title: Forced-labor Section 301 tariffs apply
detail: USTR's tariffs apply to goods entered on or after 12:01 a.m. ET, at 12.5% for products of China and for investigated economies not otherwise listed, except as the annexes provide.
who: Importers of goods from the investigated economies

title: Comment deadline: IEEPA refund worksheet
detail: Comments on CBP's Court-Ordered Refunds under IEEPA Worksheet were due by this date.
who: Importers due court-ordered IEEPA tariff refunds

title: CBP enhanced enforcement of IOR data begins
detail: CBP warns that inaccurate importer of record information may result in immediate voiding of IOR numbers.

title: FY2027 customs user fees required
detail: The adjusted fees apply, with a merchandise processing fee minimum of $34.58 and maximum of $670.86.

title: Postal rule compliance date for 19 CFR 145.12(a)(2)(v)-(vi)
detail: This is the compliance date for 19 CFR 145.12(a)(2)(v) and (vi) under CBP's postal de minimis rule.

title: Comment deadline: supply chain disclosures
detail: Comments are due on CBP's notice on amending its regulations for greater visibility into the supply chains of imported goods.
who: Importers and anyone wishing to comment

title: Comment deadline: low-value shipments proposal
detail: Comments are due on CBP's proposal to create entry type 13 for mail shipments of $2,500 or less and require a basic importation and entry bond for entry type 11 and 13 filers.
who: Importers and filers of low-value entries

title: Foreign importer of record rule takes effect
detail: CBP's interim final rule sets new requirements for foreign importers of record when making entry.

title: De minimis exemption terminated by statute
detail: CBP states that the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, enacted July 4, 2025, terminated the de minimis exemption effective this date.
